name: Beach & Corniche
hero_subtitle: Sand, promenade and ocean at the foot of the walls.

overview.title: The city beach under the ramparts
overview.p1: El Jadida beach stretches along the corniche, right at the foot of the ramparts. It is the natural extension of a visit to the Portuguese City.
overview.p2: The promenade is lively in the late afternoon: families, joggers and tea stalls. The sand is fine and the view of the walls is unique on the Moroccan coast.
overview.p3: For a quieter swim, many prefer Haouzia or Sidi Bouzid a few kilometres away.

q1.question: How much time for Beach?
q1.answer: 30 to 60 minutes is usually enough for a good visit.

q2.question: Is there an entry fee?
q2.answer: Many outdoor areas are free; the cistern has a ticket. Check on site.

q3.question: Can I visit with children?
q3.answer: Yes, most sites are suitable for families with basic supervision.

q4.question: Is it open every day?
q4.answer: Outdoor sites are generally accessible daily; indoor sites may close one day a week.

q5.question: Do I need a guide?
q5.answer: Not required, but a local guide enriches the history of the Portuguese City.
